thread:
incident-bot: PAGE: p99 spike detected on /v1/chat/stream at 2026-04-01T11:02:47Z. p99 ~1.9s (baseline ~0.38s). Multiple streaming stalls and client reconnects. Recent config: quant profile 'int8-profileset-3' rolled to hosted-eu-west ~10:50Z.

sre-oncall: ack. pulling traces/dumps now. pinging @anna-ml and @mike-eng for calibration/kernel help. @frank-sre can you grab flamegraphs and kernel logs?

anna-ml: initial telemetry shows dequant path tail growth for contexts >1200 tokens. KV cache hit rates normal. dequant_kernel_alpha shows heavy tail; median up ~2.8x vs previous profile. suspect new calibration histogram bins causing misaligned vector ops.

mike-eng: client repros show streaming chunks then 250-600ms idle gaps before next chunk. Matches kernel-side stalls. Also seeing generator thread backpressure.

frank-sre: uploaded artifacts to /opt/incidents/1783204567/. added flamegraphs, kernel timelines, and per-pod perf logs.

sre-oncall: mitigation options: 1) rollback quant profile to int8-profileset-2 (fast), 2) enable fp16-escape route for streaming (needs warmup), 3) shift traffic off eu-west hosted pool to other region/dedicated (requires capacity check). Which should we do now?

anna-ml: 1 is fastest. profileset-2 had known stable dequant paths. profileset-3 introduced extra branching in dequant loop due to narrow bin edges -> non-coalesced loads.

mike-eng: I'll run rollback. Command: `rollout quant-profile int8-profileset-2 --scope hosted-eu-west --force`. Note: will trigger rolling restarts of inference pods; expect ~4-7m stabilization and short KV cold-miss window.

dinesh-sre: propose temporary soft-rate-limit on streaming route to blunt burstiness during rollout. sample patch: 
``
route /v1/chat/streaming {
  rate_limit: 80rps
  burst: 20
  duration: 20m
}
```
Apply while rollback happens.

jess-support: multiple tickets from customers reporting reconnects and incomplete streams. Marking impacted tenants as P1 for now. If mitigation >15m we'll send a customer bulletin.

lina-prod: preparing a short status note for affected customers; will hold publish until we see progress.

sre-oncall: executing rollback and applying throttling. tagging deploy-bot.

deploy-bot: rollback job started (job id rb-1783204567). Rolling pods in batches of 3. ETA per batch ~50s. Will post updates.

deploy-bot: batch 1/6 rolled. health checks passing.

mike-eng: kernel traces point to `dequant_kernel_alpha` doing repeated small memcpy + reduction loops for certain quant bins introduced by profileset-3; these cause serialization at high concurrency.

anna-ml: yes the calibration histogram in profileset-3 created many narrow bins around mid-range activations, leading to extra compute per token for certain value ranges. It's rare but hits long contexts more.

frank-sre: flamegraph hotspot correlates with streaming chunk flush boundaries. p99 traces show dequant hotloop blocking flushes.

deploy-bot: batch 3/6 rolled.

sre-oncall: p99 trending down from 1.9s to ~0.95s after batch 3. still above baseline but improving.

dinesh-sre: throttling applied. global streaming RPS down ~18%. transient 5xx spike during restarts, now decaying.

jess-support: sent early note to affected customers with current mitigation steps. No escalations to exec yet.

deploy-bot: rollback complete. All pods at int8-profileset-2 revision. health checks green.

sre-oncall: dashboards: p99 ~0.47s, p95 ~0.35s. Streaming stall reports dropped significantly. Marking immediate mitigation complete; shifting to monitoring window.

anna-ml: recommendation: block int8-profileset-3 from auto-rollout, run offline calibration rework focusing on long-context streaming workloads, and add kernel microbench to calibration CI.

mike-eng: filing ticket CALIB-TICKET-2033: tasks - reproduce long-context streaming case, microbench `dequant_kernel_alpha`, redesign binning to avoid narrow adjacent bins, add rollout gating for tail latency regressions.

lina-prod: customer comms draft ready: we rolled back profileset-3, applied temporary throttling, and will follow up with a detailed postmortem in 24-48h. Attach latency graphs and mitigation timeline.

jess-support: two enterprise customers requested tenant-specific graphs and a touchpoint. @mike-eng can you prepare per-tenant latency PDFs?

mike-eng: will generate and attach per-tenant graphs + kernel timeline.

frank-sre: incident metadata note: severity Sev2 (customer-visible impact but mitigated quickly). Start: 2026-04-01T11:02:47Z, mitigation complete: 2026-04-01T11:21:39Z. Artifacts: traces, flamegraphs, kernel logs linked.

sre-oncall: handing off follow-up to post-incident oncall. @dinesh-sre will you lead the postmortem?

dinesh-sre: taking postmortem ownership. will draft timeline, include kernel-level evidence, and propose rollout gating changes. Postmortem target: 2026-04-02.

lina-prod: scheduled exec review 2026-04-02 09:00 UTC. include rollout gating and emergency rollback runbook.

jess-support: closing customer loop for now; will reopen if customers request.

incident-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED 1783204567 - rollback + throttling successful; monitoring window 4h. Postmortem assigned to dinesh-sre. Reopen pager if p99 regresses.
